title: Short Stirling EH988
memorial_details: SIMPLE GARDEN OF REMEMBRANCE CONTAINING STONE OF REMEMBRANCE, BENCH AND INTERPRETIVE PANEL WITH A PICTURE OF A STIRLING BOMBER. THE ROUGHLY-RECTANGULAR, ROUGH HEWN STONE HAS A POLISHED FRONT FACE WITH INCISED BLACK LETTERING AND A RAF CREST TOP LEFT CORNER.
inscription: IN MEMORY OF/ THE CREW OF/ STIRLING BOMBER EH988/ WHICH CRASHED NEAR THIS SITE/ ON 14TH JANUARY 1945/ (Names)/ IN FRIENDSHIP AND IN SERVICE/ WE WILL REMEMBER THEM/ (maker)1998
community_connection: In Memory of/In Friendship And in Service
